falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Sustained complacency at pre-correction levels would falsify the bottom pattern, which requires elevated uncertainty; a 40 blowoff score with sub-12 VIX indicates a genuine risk-on regime, not a bear market bottom

falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This divergent macro regime (stocks and yields rallying together) contradicts the bottom_2024_aug template, where yields fell as equities stabilized; it signals growth reacceleration rather than the growth scare that typifies that bottom pattern
